arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a nice, clean start, but I noticed it's quite minimal — it mainly just shows your email address. I'd suggest adding a bit more about yourself (a short bio, your interests, or what you do) and maybe a contact form or links to your work. Also, you might want to double-check which email you'd like displayed publicly, since there appear to be two listed. Looking forward to seeing it grow!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you share your passion for hiking — it's a great topic with lots of potential for engaging content. To make the blog even better, you could add more detail like trip reports, photos, trail recommendations, and tips for different skill levels. A consistent posting schedule and an "About" section would also help readers connect with you. Keep it up!
